designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system blends futuristic Japanese cyber-aesthetic with the precision, quiet restraint, and tactile richness of luxury consumer technology. It deliberately rejects the bubblegum triviality often associated with pink palettes by enforcing a rigorous 60/30/10 tonal balance: deep, light-absorbing plum-obsidian serves as the architectural void (60%), structural planes of smoky amethyst and titanium rose-graphite form the analytical body (30%), and singular, laser-sharp shocks of electric neon sakura provide intense cognitive focus (10%).

The aesthetic mood is atmospheric, nocturnal, and surgical. Interfaces feel like a high-grade orbital flight console rendered in black cherry lacquer, carbon fiber, and illuminated neon phosphor. It serves discerning power users who require technical density without sensory fatigue, evoking a distinct sense of hyper-modern elegance, subcultural rebellion, and calibrated technical precision.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built on an exact 8pt spatial cadence (with 4pt half-steps for compact UI modules). Surfaces are engineered using an adaptive fluid grid:

- **Mobile (Viewport < 768px)**: 4-column system with `1rem` margins and `0.75rem` internal gutters. Navigation compresses into an elevated bottom floating dock or an edge-anchored glass drawer.
- **Tablet (Viewport 768px – 1024px)**: 8-column layout with `1.5rem` margins and `1rem` gutters. Side rails collapse into icon-only vertical tracks.
- **Desktop (Viewport > 1024px)**: 12-column dynamic framework with `2.5rem` outer margins and `1.5rem` column gutters. Maximum application canvas tops out at `1440px` with ambient margin bleeds.

Content densities must honor structural groupings: tightly coupled operational units (e.g., input field clusters, metric blocks) maintain dense padding (`space-xs` through `space-md`), while global layout modules sit in breathable containment islands separated by generous structural chasms (`space-xl` through `space-3xl`).

## Elevation & Depth

Visual depth is achieved through translucent planar layering, hairline specular rims, and directional colored luminescence rather than generic neutral drop shadows.

- **Surface Tiers**:
  - **Base Canvas (Elevation 0)**: Void plum `#140f17`. Absorbs light; houses canvas grid overlays and subtle atmospheric radial glow fields.
  - **Container Level 1 (Elevation 1)**: `#1c1522` at 90% opacity with `16px` backdrop-filter blur and a 1px border stroke of `rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.08)`.
  - **Raised Modules & Flyouts (Elevation 2)**: `#251c2e` with `24px` backdrop blur, anchored by a dual border: a top rim highlight of `rgba(255, 133, 161, 0.2)` and side/bottom bounding strokes of `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)`.
  - **Floating Overlays & Modals (Elevation 3)**: `#2e2238` with `32px` backdrop blur and an ambient downward cast shadow: `0 20px 48px -12px rgba(8, 4, 12, 0.8), 0 0 32px 0 rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.06)`.
- **Specular Edge Rims**: Surface edges are carved using sharp `1px` inside border gradients running from subtle rose-quartz highlight at the upper edge to transparent black-cherry at the base, creating a polished obsidian and titanium bevel aesthetic.
- **Sakura Glow Field**: Interactive active states cast an electric neon aura (`box-shadow: 0 0 24px -4px rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.45)`), conveying hot-wire excitation under user input.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Cyber-Sakura Action**: Background in solid electric magenta `#ff2a7a` with typography set in `#140f17` Space Grotesk Bold. Features a subtle inner glow `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)` and an external aura `0 4px 16px rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.35)`. Hover intensifies the glow to `0 6px 24px rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.55)` with an upward translate of `1px`.
- **Secondary (Obsidian Glass)**: Background set to `rgba(37, 28, 46, 0.7)` with a `1px` border of `rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.2)`. Text in `#fbeff3`. On hover, the border brightens to `rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.6)` with a soft plum-lit backdrop.
- **Ghost / Utility**: No initial border or fill. Rose titanium typography (`#9d82a5`) turning into glowing `#ff2a7a` on cursor proximity.

### Input Fields
- Enclosed within dark plum basins (`#1a1320`) with inset shadow `inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)` and a discreet border stroke `rgba(157, 130, 165, 0.2)`.
- Text color is `#fbeff3`; placeholder text is muted mauve `#635069`.
- **Focus State**: Activates an uninterrupted `1px` border of `#ff2a7a` accompanied by a localized neon halo (`box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.25)`).

### Cards & Analytical Panels
- Composed of Container Level 1 surfaces with `1rem` corner rounding.
- Headers are marked by an ultra-thin horizontal divider in `rgba(157, 130, 165, 0.12)`.
- Critical card states (selected, active, or triggered) display an upper edge highlight band (2px) in vibrant `#ff2a7a`.

### Chips, Pills & Badges
- **Status Pills**: Pill-shaped geometry. Default neutral variant runs on `rgba(157, 130, 165, 0.12)` fill with titanium text (`#bda6c3`).
- **Active / Filtered**: Glowing neon border `rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.5)` with deep translucent magenta background `rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.12)` and high-contrast `#ff85a1` label text.

### Selection Controls (Checkboxes & Radios)
- Checkboxes feature an 8px radius or squircle shell (`#1c1522`) bordered by `rgba(157, 130, 165, 0.3)`. When checked, the box transitions instantly to glowing `#ff2a7a` with a deep obsidian check icon (`#140f17`).
- Radio toggles follow identical color logic with an elevated inner phosphor dot.

### Lists & Data Grids
- Data rows sit on transparent planes separated by hairline borders `rgba(157, 130, 165, 0.08)`.
- Hover triggers an instantaneous glide transition to `rgba(255, 42, 122, 0.04)` fill with a luminous 2px left border accent in `#ff2a7a`.

### Specialized Luxury-Tech Elements
- **HUD Telemetry Chips**: Monospace Space Grotesk data badges with an integrated pulsing cyber-sakura LED indicator dot.
- **Neon Scrim Overlays**: Modal backdrops leverage deep obsidian plum `#0d0910` at 85% opacity paired with a heavy optical blur (`20px`), directing high-contrast focus to foreground interactive dialogue modules.

Secondary text and structural framing live strictly within these mid-density frequencies.
- **10% High-Voltage Focal Accents (`#ff2a7a`, `#ff85a1`)**: Laser-bright neon sakura and cyber-magenta. These are reserved exclusively for critical interactive drivers: affirmative actions, active states, active tab pill indicators, real-time telemetry markers, and focused input boundaries. They are never diluted into broad background washes.
- **Micro-functional Accents**: Success states lean into vibrant electric emerald-cyan (`#00f5a0`), warnings adopt hot neon amber (`#ffb703`), and critical errors utilize razor crimson (`#ff1744`), each calibrated to match the luminescent intensity of the primary sakura accent.

## Typography

The typographic hierarchy implements a high-tension dual-pairing:

- **Display, Headlines, and Interface Labels (`Space Grotesk`)**: Provides an engineered, tech-forward, futuristic cadence. Structural numbers, metric readouts, tags, badges, and primary section headers rely on its geometric cut and distinctive technical quirks. Uppercase applications for small labels (`label-sm`, `label-md`) must always carry open tracking (`0.05em` to `0.08em`) to mimic instrumentation panels.
- **Reading Typography and Extended Body (`Plus Jakarta Sans`)**: Neutralizes the cold mechanical feel of the headline face with balanced geometric humanities, wide apertures, and legible letterforms. It ensures long-form documentation, logs, tables, and settings menus remain effortless to read against deep obsidian backgrounds.
